newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end sharply lower, near lows.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end sharply lower, near lows.

text.p: March 13 - U.S. debt futures ended sharply lower, near lows. Big dealer sales hit June T-bonds, broke 108-23/32 support. Some look for 108-00 or below soon. Futures skidded when Fed vice chairman Rivlin said US economy perking along well, Fed must be vigilant of threat of faster inflation. Friday's Feb US PPI seen down 0.1 pct, core rate seen up 0.1 pct.
